title: Ñi dëkk ci ñaari jardin yi
intro: Ci réew mu bari ay barke, amoon na benn askan bu amoon ñaari jardin yu rafet. Seen dundu dafay firndeel yitte Yàlla, waaye seen jaar-jaar dafa soppeeku ginaaw bi ngërëm wàññeekoo, mu indi coppite buy nekk màndarga buy yàgg ci képp ku ci xalaat.
clues: Nun askan wuñ barkeel la woon ci réew mu yomb te bari ay mbir.
Sunu Boroom may nu ñaari jardin yu rafet, yu naat te bari ay meññeef fu nekk.
Dañu nu digal nu gërëm Yàlla, waaye nu tànn ñàkka ngërëm, nu dellu ginaaw.
Baraas bu rëy moo tëjoon ndox miy dundal sunu suuf.
Bi nu wéyee ci sunuy njuumte, barage bi dafa toj, ndox mi di wal.
Sunu jardin yi yàgg a naat, ñu jël ay meññeef yu wex, ay tamarisk ak ay garabi lote yu néew.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Ngelaw lu metti juróom ñaari guddi
Xeer yu bari yuy wàcci ci asamaan si
Mbënd buy yàq bu bawoo ci barab buy toj
ab yuuxu bu am doole joge asamaan
trial.answer: Mbënd buy yàq bu bawoo ci barab buy toj

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Sunu jardin yi dañu wecci ay meññeef yu wex ak garab yu néew
Suuf si daf nu wann ci yëngu-yëngu suuf
ñu soppi nu nekk maymu ak mbaam xuux
Mbënd mu rëy moo nu mbëgg
Xeer yu bari ñoo nu yàq
outcome.answer: Sunu jardin yi dañu wecci ay meññeef yu wex ak garab yu néew

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
